about: TP-3745 seeded-mutation variants. Each seed is the smallest edit to a frozen fixture script that trips one RF lint family; `edits` are JSON pointers into the base fixture set to `value` (an index one past the end appends). `check` is the issue check the seed must produce.

v4-bands-stake-late.seed: The hook beat planned at 112 s instead of 6 s, so the first STAKE beat starts after 15 % of the planned total

review-addendum-v5-bands-stake-late.seed: The first beat planned at 32 s instead of 13 s, so the STAKE beat starts after 15 % of the planned total

v4-sentence-long.seed: Two sentences of a v4 beat joined into one of 29 words

edits.value: One sentence explains it: a recipe is a script, a step is memoized at its head, a wait or claim is a return, and an event re-enters the script.

v4-banned-simply.seed: "simply" inserted into a v4 beat's narration

edits.value: The redesign simply keeps, removes and adds parts, and leaves eleven calls to you.

v4-numbers-forty.seed: "forty" (not on the fact list, over the structure cap) inserted into a v4 beat's narration

edits.value: The redesign keeps, removes and adds forty parts, and leaves eleven calls to you.

v4-outro-long.seed: The 8-word cap on the outro: two words added; the beat is v2, so the reused-narration check also fires

edits.value: Find the wake, and you find the wait it hides.

review-addendum-v5-outro-long.seed: The addendum's 25-word cap on the closing beat: four words added

edits.value: Version six is being written to answer both reviews, and another adversary round follows. Until you decide, each fix is only a proposal, not a change.
